release.scope: Phase7-K final frozen production Chromium QA: final 60s regression, 7200s integrated stress, and 3600s content-focused runner-driven Agent Exploratory; no public release or human product approval.
release.head: e05cc78f1ef452e2672df223f2febf48444dcbd3
conditions: Full `npm run check` passed after PixelWindow fix: 37 files / 627 tests, typecheck and build passed.
41 Phase7 browser runner contract tests pass against the frozen QA harness; runner and test SHA-256 values are recorded in this manifest.

Checkpoint browserState records NPC registry totals/alive/dead separately from retained-history NPC death events; history scope, 20,000-row cap and possible incompleteness are explicit. It also records settlement, active-character/economy, threat/Boss/crisis, events/history/journal and save bytes; unavailable fields are null and marked unsupported.
IndexedDB record sampling uses a bounded projection before JSON serialization; truncated samples or serialization errors suppress store-total estimates. The Node projection contract passes.

Final acceptance remains a 7,200-second stress lane and 3,600-second content-agent lane; a 60-second regression is smoke-only. Runner heartbeat watchdog is 120s and terminates/reaps the runner process group on stale heartbeat.
Root verifies final build, dist, source, and current QA runner provenance before every Browser run.
Human product validation remains DEFERRED / NOT APPLICABLE AT THIS STAGE.
